title: Kaishun Professional Cheese Grater, 4-Sided Stainless Steel Box Grater, Food Shredder for Cheese, Parmesan, Vegetable, Black
description:
About this item
Firmly fixed, no worry about grater slip during your job: Be careful! The finger gets hurt easily when the sharp blade you're using gets slipped! Our product is designed with an ergonomic handle and rubber base, which can efficiently avoid slipping during use and reduce the risk of finger cutting.
Easy to use: A wide range of different sharp blades help you grind a variety of foods efficiently, including cheese, vegetables, chocolate, and more.
Durable: High-quality stainless steel blade and say goodbye to the trouble of rust. sharp and durable. Product dimensions 7.8x 5.1 x4.1inches
Easy hand washing but also dishwasher safe: In the case of handwashing, you can simply clean it under running water. And if you own a dishwasher, things become easier--what you need to do is put this box grater in the machine! Please be aware that, we recommend you take the removable rubber base off before washing it. This will make sure you clean all the mess that may be hidden in the rubber base and farewell to the risk of any rust happening.
Excellent service: In case of any unhappiness during your purchase, we offer you a satisfaction-guaranteed after-sale service. Please contact us through the order page, we'll reply to you within 12 hours and solve your problem with 48 hours!

As shown does what i neededIt was a gift so yes. feedback was positive.Good stainless steel grater. Finally replaced the old one we have had since early marriage.
Love the non-slip feature, easily cleaned, the right size and shape. It's plenty sharp for grating and a good buy.Very comfortable, easy to use and clean!Purchased primarily for cheese. Just tried it, and it works wonderfully! I was able to grate several bricks of cheese quickly and cleanly. Nice, uniform grating with no mess. Definitely better/more uniform results than grating with my Cuisinart, and much faster and easier to clean up afterward. (Remove rubber guard around the base, then hand-wash each separately.)
